title: test(app-shell): load the designers module at module scope so the entry registration wait covers only its .then (objectui#12478)
body:
Fixes #12478
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/entryRegistersBuiltinDesigners-11939.test.tsx` now imports `../views/metadata-admin/register-builtin-designers` at module scope. It imports the module and never calls it. The header comment is corrected. `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` is unchanged. The change set also has an empty-frontmatter changeset because only the test changed.

## Why: the race, measured

The PM's mechanism assumption was that the test's module-scope imports had already cached the designers' module graph. That was only partly true. The test imported 3 components (`FlowPreview`, `FlowInspector`, `HookDefaultInspector`). The module the entry's `import()` names pulls `previews/index.ts` (22 previews) and `inspectors/index.ts` (13 inspector modules), so about 32 modules were still uncached. They were transformed and evaluated inside `vi.waitFor`'s default 1000 ms window. Since objectui#12187 the entry hands the loader to `deferBuiltinDesigners`. The test's own read before the entry import (`listMetadataPreviewTypes()`) sets `wanted`, so the loader starts as soon as the entry is evaluated.

Measured with scratch copies of the test (later deleted), 3 runs each, `--maxWorkers=1`, on a shared box. "tests" is the in-test wait:

| shape | tests time |
|---|---|
| main's imports (3 components) | 917 ms, 924 ms, 935 ms |
| plus `register-builtin-designers` at module scope | 9 ms, 8 ms, 6 ms |

So on a quiet box main already used about 92% of the 1000 ms budget, and a slow CI shard (`import 584.89s`) went over it. This is the AGENTS.md 测试纪律 pattern: the unbounded module load moves to the import phase, where no test timeout applies.

## Why this option and not a longer timeout

- No timeout was raised. AGENTS.md 测试纪律 rules out raising timeouts as a flake fix. The default `vi.waitFor` now covers only the `.then` microtasks.
- No new export, public or internal. The loader's promise is discarded (`void loader()` in `builtin-designers-loader.ts`), so awaiting it would have needed a new handle. Moving the import needed none.
- The test still proves the same thing:
  - `register-builtin-designers.ts` has no load-time effect. It only exports `registerBuiltinDesigners`, and so do `previews/index.ts` and `inspectors/index.ts`.
  - Nothing in the test calls it.
  - The registries are still read empty after every static import has evaluated, so a registrar added to that graph would turn `typesBeforeTheEntry` red.
  - The identity assertions are unchanged.

## Evidence (head `dbf8bc3ad`)

- **20× loop, under the shared lock:** `PASS_COUNT=20/20`. In-test time per run was 6 to 11 ms.
- **Ablation:** run with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The entry's `.then(({ registerBuiltinDesigners }) => registerBuiltinDesigners())` was replaced with `.then(() => undefined)`.
  - The anchor went from 1 hit to 0, and the blob changed from `498f6b8705dd` to `c4e9bf077780`.
  - The test went red: `AssertionError: expected undefined to be [Function FlowPreview]` after 1017 ms, `Tests 1 failed (1)`.
  - Restore: the blob is back to `498f6b8705dd`, matching HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - So the test still fails when the entry stops registering.
- **`packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/` (whole directory):** `Test Files 22 passed (22)`, `Tests 436 passed (436)`.
- **`pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`:** exit 0, run after building the dependency closure (`--filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`, exit 0). `tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists this test file.
- **ESLint (`--no-inline-config`, changed file only):**
  - 1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings (counts read from `--format json`).
  - No ESLint rule uses type information (no `parserOptions.project` in `eslint.config.js`), so this change cannot change lint results for files it does not touch.
- **`pnpm check:control-bytes`:** exit 0.
- **`node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`:** exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `register-builtin-designers.ts`'s header comment says the entry calls the loader "at its own module scope". Since objectui#12187 the entry hands it to `deferBuiltinDesigners`, and the first registry read runs it. That comment is out of date, but this PR does not touch that file. Carrier: none.
